_comment: Served by GET /api/model-info and rendered on the app's How It Works page. Numbers are the ResNet50 (production) results from the MediVision Part E Final Report, Table 4, plus per-class detail from the confusion-matrix and ROC figures. All figures are on held-out test sets with bootstrap 95% CIs (1,000 resamples). Keep this in sync whenever you retrain.
evaluation_dataset: 35,884 deduplicated medical images spanning 24 disease classes across 3 domains (skin, eye, teeth), aggregated from Kaggle, ISIC, and Roboflow sources, plus a 4,500-image domain-routing subset. A 70/15/15 train/validation/test split was applied, stratified by class and verified free of path-level leakage. Melanocytic Nevus was capped at 3,500 training samples; seven minority skin classes were upsampled to 2,000 each; Dry Eye and Uveitis were augmented with 150 neural-style-transfer synthetic images each.

pipeline_end_to_end.notes: Full domain-router -> disease-classifier pipeline measured end-to-end on a 5,648-image stress test.

metrics.notes: Routing accuracy on a held-out 675-image test set (only 3 misroutes). Macro AUC effectively 1.0; every class achieves AUC >= 0.997.

Hardest task (11 classes, high inter-class similarity). Strongest on the clinically critical malignant classes: Melanoma sensitivity 0.96 / F1 0.97 / AUC 0.999, BCC F1 0.92. Weaker on visually similar inflammatory dermatoses (Atopic Dermatitis F1 0.56). Melanoma sensitivity is the row-normalized recall from the confusion matrix.
384x384 inputs. Macro AUC 0.996, with Normal and Cataract achieving near-perfect AUC = 1.000.
Highest single-domain accuracy. Key limitation: Caries recall is only 0.53 on 36 test samples (precision 1.00), so about half of true caries cases are missed - see MODEL_CARD.md roadmap.

ood_gate.method: softmax confidence + normalized entropy on the domain router
ood_gate.caveat: Heuristic only - see MODEL_CARD.md roadmap for a trained OOD detector.
